description: Curated non-exclusive exploration crosswalk: career-interest pathway codes -> existing academic schools. This is not algorithmically validated matching or eligibility.
scoring: Top three assessment interests are used only to order relevant schools; no numeric career-to-course affinity or admission readiness is calculated.

pathways.name: Arts & Entertainment
pathways.description: Explore creative techniques, storytelling, performance and portfolios.

pathways.name: Architecture & Engineering
pathways.description: Use mathematical, digital and design foundations; the directory does not currently verify a professional architecture program.

pathways.name: Business Management & Administration
pathways.description: Explore enterprise, management, finance and service operations.

pathways.name: Communications
pathways.description: Practice writing, languages, media, presentation and storytelling.

pathways.name: Community & Social Services
pathways.description: Explore ethics, social contexts, psychology and civic service; no clinical or social-work license is conferred.

pathways.name: Education
pathways.description: Build foundations in language, learning, inquiry and interpretation; teacher licensure is separate.

pathways.name: Science & Technology
pathways.description: Explore mathematics, programming, weather science and research methods.

pathways.name: Installation, Repair & Maintenance
pathways.description: Start with supporting technical and numerical study. A complete trade-apprenticeship course is not yet verified.

pathways.name: Farming, Fishing & Forestry
pathways.description: Explore climate, environmental observations, food systems and land knowledge. Not a professional farming or forestry qualification.

pathways.name: Government
pathways.description: Explore governance, historical evidence, public institutions and ethics.

pathways.name: Health & Medicine
pathways.description: Explore health literacy, psychology, nutrition and environment. Nothing here replaces accredited medical or clinical training.

pathways.name: Law & Public Policy
pathways.description: Explore evidence, law, ethics, public policy and historical contexts; not law-school qualification.

pathways.name: Sales & Customer Service
pathways.description: Explore business, communication, customer experience and creative presentation.
